Tunnel Trouble#000.src: Talk to Captain Fenor in front of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Tunnel Trouble#001.src: Ah! You must be a new recruit! Well, I've got a mission for you.
Tunnel Trouble#001.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#002.src: There's an old cave behind me. It was used in the Corruption Wars...
Tunnel Trouble#002.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#003.src: We used it for quick and easy travel between {p} and {p}. It’s been abandoned for years.
Tunnel Trouble#003.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#004.src: This cave could prove to be very useful for future recruits who need to travel between {p} and {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#004.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#005.src: Now, here's where you come in - I need you to clear out that cave route so we can use it once more! Good luck, soldier!
Tunnel Trouble#005.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#006.src: Enter the cave behind Captain Fenor at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Tunnel Trouble#007.src: ...Oh! Shoot, is it time to get to work already?
Tunnel Trouble#007.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#009.src: Uh... well, to start, we'll need to clear that debris. Just... give it a shove, or something. That'll probably do it.
Tunnel Trouble#009.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#010.src: Help Miner Linton remove the debris blocking the path.

Tunnel Trouble#011.src: Pretty easy, huh? Hey, maybe you can just go on ahead, and do the rest yourself?
Tunnel Trouble#011.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#012.src: ...Yeah, no, I should probably do my job. Let me grab my pickaxe, and we can keep going forward.
Tunnel Trouble#012.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#013.src: Clear the cave of possible roadblocks.

Tunnel Trouble#014.src: Oh, come on... Hey, soldier, do your job! Get rid of those monsters, would you?
Tunnel Trouble#014.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#016.src: A cave-in? Really? More work for me... I'll make us a way through, just keep fighting those corrupteds!
Tunnel Trouble#016.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#017.src: Halfway there... Ugh, I knew I should have brought explosives...
Tunnel Trouble#017.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#018.src: I can see the other side! Just a little more...
Tunnel Trouble#018.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#019.src: There we go, I've made us a hole! Get over here, quickly!
Tunnel Trouble#019.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#020.src: ...Oh, come on. You've got to be kidding me. Another cave-in? Really?
Tunnel Trouble#020.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#021.src: And of course it's bigger than the last one. What's my pickaxe going to do against this thing?!
Tunnel Trouble#021.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#022.src: Really should have thought to bring explosives. Well, soldier, we tried our best! Nobody'll blame us if we give up now.
Tunnel Trouble#022.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#023.src: ...What? Don't look at me like that. Fine, we can- huh? Do you hear that? Over there, to the right.
Tunnel Trouble#023.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#024.src: Oh, uh... Hi... Well, this is a little awkward... I'll just... Go.

Tunnel Trouble#025.src: ...You know what? I'm not going to ask. As far as I'm concerned, that didn't happen.
Tunnel Trouble#025.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#026.src: Right, of course you want to check it out. Fine! Go ahead. I'll just... sit here and twiddle my thumbs 'till you're back.
Tunnel Trouble#026.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#027.src: Investigate the small hole to the right of the large pile of debris.

Tunnel Trouble#028.src: Oh... Didn't expect you to follow me... Well, um... Hi! This will sound mad but...
Tunnel Trouble#028.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#029.src: I'm Drale, and I'm on a mission to free these cows from the enslavement of {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#029.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#030.src: Those farmers stole those cows. They are sacred animals. Now they're about to turn them into steak! If you were to help me, maybe I could help you...
Tunnel Trouble#030.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#031.src: Go free those innocent cows from enslavement! Qu-quickly! Before that farmer gets back...
Tunnel Trouble#031.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#032.src: Where are you going? Come here and talk to me first.
Tunnel Trouble#032.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#033.src: Free the cows without being seen by the farmer.

Tunnel Trouble#034.src: Go free the cows from the farmers before they're taken to the slaughterhouse! Oh man, the slaughterhouse...
Tunnel Trouble#034.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#035.src: Ah, good to see my cows are all in tip-top shape! Welp, time to- gah!
Tunnel Trouble#035.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#036.src: An intruder! What are you doing with my cows!? Guard golem, attack!
Tunnel Trouble#036.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#038.src: Golem! No! That cost me thousands of emeralds!
Tunnel Trouble#038.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#039.src: Return to Drale about your success.

Tunnel Trouble#040.src: Thank you so much, but we're not done yet. We need to get these cows out the province.
Tunnel Trouble#040.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#041.src: There's a small opening behind me. Go through it and help me get these cows on a raft to Gavel!
Tunnel Trouble#041.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#042.src: Help Drale push the raft with the cows out to sea.

Tunnel Trouble#043.src: There's the raft! Help me push it for the cows!
Tunnel Trouble#043.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#044.src: And, that should do it! Be free, my friends! A new life awaits!
Tunnel Trouble#044.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#045.src: Again, thank you so much for what you have done this day. These cows deserve a better life than being farm animals.
Tunnel Trouble#045.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#046.src: ...Oh! Right! You were busy with something before you came to help me, weren't you? Hm... I think I might be able to help you with that as well! Let's go back to the tunnel!
Tunnel Trouble#046.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#047.src: Return to Miner Linton back in the abandoned cave.

Tunnel Trouble#048.src: Oh, good, you're back. It's been, like, an hour! What were you even doing for that long!
Tunnel Trouble#048.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#049.src: ...You helped some crazy cow-obsessed lunatic steal some cows? I don't think you're allowed to do that. There's a law against that, or something.
Tunnel Trouble#049.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#050.src: Eh. Not that I really care, either way. I've certainly done worse.
Tunnel Trouble#050.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#051.src: Well then! Ready to call it quits? We're definitely not going to make any progress, so we might as we-
Tunnel Trouble#051.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#052.src: Hello again, friend! I'm here with help! Cows, to me!
Tunnel Trouble#052.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#054.src: Since you helped me with my problem, I thought I should repay that favor by helping you!
Tunnel Trouble#054.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#055.src: Welp, see ya! Oh, and nice to meet you, miner! Now, let's get going my cows!
Tunnel Trouble#055.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#056.src: ...I- huh. You saw that too, right? I didn't just imagine that?
Tunnel Trouble#056.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#057.src: You know what? I think I quit. I think this has finally pushed me to my limit! I didn't know that I had one, but apparently I do!
Tunnel Trouble#057.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#058.src: You can... go on ahead. Tell whoever's on the other end that we succeeded. And while we do that, I'll be searching for a better career.
Tunnel Trouble#058.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#060.src: Speak to Sergeant Klafson next to the {p} entrance of the cave.

Tunnel Trouble#061.src: Recruit, Captain Fenor told me to meet you here, said if you came out on this side of that tunnel then you completed your mission!
Tunnel Trouble#061.speaker: Sergeant Klafson

Tunnel Trouble#062.src: You did a great deed today, soldier! We can now use this cave to travel easily between {p} and {p}! Great job!
Tunnel Trouble#062.speaker: Sergeant Klafson
